SELECT 
    d.name AS department_name,
    COUNT(e.id) AS active_employee_count
FROM 
    analytics.employees e
JOIN 
    analytics.departments d ON e.department_id = d.id
WHERE 
    e.status = 'active'
GROUP BY 
    d.name
ORDER BY 
    active_employee_count DESC;
SELECT SUM(salary) AS total_annual_salary FROM analytics.employees WHERE status = 'active';
SELECT AVG(salary) AS average_annual_salary FROM analytics.employees WHERE status = 'active';
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM analytics.customers GROUP BY status;

SELECT 
    i.id AS invoice_id,
    i.invoice_number,
    SUM(il.quantity * il.unit_price) AS total_amount
FROM 
    analytics.invoices i
JOIN 
    analytics.invoice_lines il ON i.id = il.invoice_id
GROUP BY 
    i.id, i.invoice_number
ORDER BY 
    total_amount DESC;
SELECT category, SUM(amount) AS total_cost FROM analytics.project_costs GROUP BY category;
SELECT SUM(base_salary + bonus - deductions) AS net_payroll FROM analytics.payroll WHERE period_start >= '2025-02-01' AND period_end <= '2025-02-28';

SELECT 
    e.full_name, 
    d.name AS department_name, 
    e.salary 
FROM 
    analytics.employees e
JOIN 
    analytics.departments d ON e.department_id = d.id
WHERE 
    e.status = 'active'
ORDER BY 
    e.salary DESC;

SELECT 
    p.project_code,
    p.name AS project_name,
    c.name AS customer_name,
    d.name AS department_name
FROM 
    analytics.projects p
JOIN 
    analytics.customers c ON p.customer_id = c.id
JOIN 
    analytics.departments d ON p.owning_department_id = d.id;

SELECT 
    i.invoice_number,
    c.name AS customer_name,
    SUM(il.quantity * il.unit_price) AS total_invoice_value
FROM 
    analytics.invoices i
JOIN 
    analytics.customers c ON i.customer_id = c.id
JOIN 
    analytics.invoice_lines il ON i.id = il.invoice_id
GROUP BY 
    i.invoice_number, c.name;

SELECT 
    e.full_name AS employee_name,
    p.project_code,
    epa.allocation_percent
FROM 
    analytics.employee_project_assignments epa
JOIN 
    analytics.employees e ON epa.employee_id = e.id
JOIN 
    analytics.projects p ON epa.project_id = p.id;

SELECT 
    p.project_code, 
    p.name AS project_name, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT epa.employee_id) AS assigned_employees_count
FROM 
    analytics.projects p
JOIN 
    analytics.employee_project_assignments epa ON p.id = epa.project_id
WHERE 
    p.status = 'active'
GROUP BY 
    p.project_code, 
    p.name
ORDER BY 
    assigned_employees_count DESC;

SELECT 
    c.customer_code,
    c.name AS customer_name,
    SUM(il.quantity * il.unit_price) AS total_revenue
FROM 
    analytics.invoices i
JOIN 
    analytics.invoice_lines il ON i.id = il.invoice_id
JOIN 
    analytics.customers c ON i.customer_id = c.id
WHERE 
    i.status = 'paid'
GROUP BY 
    c.customer_code, c.name
ORDER BY 
    total_revenue DESC;

SELECT 
    p.project_code,
    p.name AS project_name,
    COALESCE(SUM(il.quantity * il.unit_price), 0) AS total_revenue,
    COALESCE(SUM(pc.amount), 0) AS total_costs,
    COALESCE(SUM(il.quantity * il.unit_price), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(pc.amount), 0) AS margin
FROM 
    analytics.projects p
JOIN 
    analytics.invoices i ON p.id = i.project_id
JOIN 
    analytics.invoice_lines il ON i.id = il.invoice_id
LEFT JOIN 
    analytics.project_costs pc ON p.id = pc.project_id
GROUP BY 
    p.project_code, p.name
ORDER BY 
    margin DESC;

SELECT 
    d.name AS department_name,
    SUM(p.budget) AS total_project_budget
FROM 
    analytics.projects p
JOIN 
    analytics.departments d ON p.owning_department_id = d.id
GROUP BY 
    d.name
ORDER BY 
    total_project_budget DESC;

SELECT 
    d.name AS department_name,
    AVG(e.salary) AS avg_department_salary
FROM 
    analytics.employees e
JOIN 
    analytics.departments d ON e.department_id = d.id
WHERE 
    e.status = 'active'
GROUP BY 
    d.name
HAVING 
    AVG(e.salary) > (
        SELECT AVG(salary) 
        FROM analytics.employees 
        WHERE status = 'active'
    )
ORDER BY 
    avg_department_salary DESC;

SELECT 
    e.id AS employee_id,
    e.full_name AS employee_name,
    d.name AS department_name,
    e.salary,
    dept_avg.avg_salary AS department_avg_salary
FROM 
    analytics.employees e
JOIN 
    analytics.departments d ON e.department_id = d.id
JOIN (
    SELECT 
        department_id, 
        AVG(salary) AS avg_salary
    FROM 
        analytics.employees
    WHERE 
        status = 'active'
    GROUP BY 
        department_id
) dept_avg ON e.department_id = dept_avg.department_id
WHERE 
    e.status = 'active'
    AND e.salary > dept_avg.avg_salary;

SELECT 
    c.name AS customer_name,
    SUM(il.quantity * il.unit_price) AS total_revenue
FROM 
    analytics.customers c
JOIN 
    analytics.invoices i ON c.id = i.customer_id
JOIN 
    analytics.invoice_lines il ON i.id = il.invoice_id
GROUP BY 
    c.name
HAVING 
    SUM(il.quantity * il.unit_price) > 100000
ORDER BY 
    total_revenue DESC;

SELECT 
    p.project_code,
    p.name,
    COALESCE(SUM(pc.amount), 0) AS total_cost
FROM 
    analytics.projects p
LEFT JOIN 
    analytics.project_costs pc ON p.id = pc.project_id
GROUP BY 
    p.id, p.project_code, p.name
HAVING 
    COALESCE(SUM(pc.amount), 0) > (
        SELECT AVG(project_total_cost)
        FROM (
            SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pc_inner.amount), 0) AS project_total_cost
            FROM analytics.projects p_inner
            LEFT JOIN analytics.project_costs pc_inner ON p_inner.id = pc_inner.project_id
            GROUP BY p_inner.id
        ) subquery
    )
ORDER BY 
    total_cost DESC;

SELECT 
    d.name AS department_name,
    COUNT(e.id) AS active_employee_count
FROM 
    analytics.departments d
JOIN 
    analytics.employees e ON d.id = e.department_id
WHERE 
    e.status = 'active'
GROUP BY 
    d.name
HAVING 
    COUNT(e.id) >= 2;

SELECT 
    d.name AS department_name,
    e.full_name AS employee_name,
    e.salary AS salary
FROM (
    SELECT 
        department_id,
        full_name,
        salary,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY department_id ORDER BY salary DESC) as rn
    FROM analytics.employees
    WHERE status = 'active'
) e
JOIN analytics.departments d ON e.department_id = d.id
WHERE e.rn = 1
ORDER BY d.name;

WITH RankedSalaries AS (
    SELECT
        d.name AS department_name,
        e.full_name AS employee_name,
        e.salary,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.id ORDER BY e.salary DESC) AS rank
    FROM analytics.employees e
    JOIN analytics.departments d ON e.department_id = d.id
    WHERE e.status = 'active'
)
SELECT
    department_name,
    employee_name,
    salary
FROM RankedSalaries
WHERE rank <= 2
ORDER BY department_name, rank;

SELECT 
    i.issued_on,
    SUM(il.quantity * il.unit_price) AS daily_invoice_total,
    SUM(SUM(il.quantity * il.unit_price)) OVER (ORDER BY i.issued_on) AS cumulative_invoiced_revenue
FROM 
    analytics.invoices i
JOIN 
    analytics.invoice_lines il ON i.id = il.invoice_id
GROUP BY 
    i.issued_on
ORDER BY 
    i.issued_on;

SELECT 
    p.project_code,
    pc.category,
    SUM(pc.amount) AS total_cost,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.project_code ORDER BY SUM(pc.amount) DESC) AS cost_rank
FROM 
    analytics.project_costs pc
JOIN 
    analytics.projects p ON pc.project_id = p.id
GROUP BY 
    p.project_code, pc.category
ORDER BY 
    p.project_code, cost_rank;

SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC('month', p.period_start) AS month,
    SUM(p.base_salary) AS total_base_payroll,
    SUM(p.base_salary) - LAG(SUM(p.base_salary)) OVER (ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('month', p.period_start)) AS change_from_previous_month
FROM 
    analytics.payroll p
WHERE 
    p.period_start >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '12 months'
GROUP BY 
    DATE_TRUNC('month', p.period_start)
ORDER BY 
    month;

SELECT 
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM hire_date) AS hire_year, 
    COUNT(*) AS active_employee_count
FROM 
    analytics.employees
WHERE 
    status = 'active'
GROUP BY 
    hire_year
ORDER BY 
    hire_year;

SELECT 
    p.project_code,
    p.name,
    SUM(pc.amount) AS total_cost
FROM 
    analytics.project_costs pc
JOIN 
    analytics.projects p ON pc.project_id = p.id
WHERE 
    pc.cost_date >= '2025-02-01' AND pc.cost_date <= '2025-02-28'
GROUP BY 
    p.project_code, p.name
ORDER BY 
    total_cost DESC;

SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC('month', period_start) AS month,
    SUM(base_salary + bonus - deductions) AS net_payroll
FROM 
    analytics.payroll
WHERE 
    period_start >= '2025-01-01' 
    AND period_start < '2025-03-01'
GROUP BY 
    DATE_TRUNC('month', period_start)
ORDER BY 
    month;
SELECT project_code, name FROM analytics.projects WHERE status = 'active' AND start_date <= '2025-02-01' AND end_date >= '2025-02-01';

SELECT 
    d.name AS department_name,
    SUM(p.base_salary + p.bonus - p.deductions) AS total_annual_payroll
FROM 
    analytics.payroll p
JOIN 
    analytics.employees e ON p.employee_id = e.id
JOIN 
    analytics.departments d ON e.department_id = d.id
WHERE 
    e.status = 'active'
    AND p.status = 'paid'
    AND p.period_start >= DATE_TRUNC('year', CURRENT_DATE)
    AND p.period_end < DATE_TRUNC('year', CURRENT_DATE) + INTERVAL '1 year'
GROUP BY 
    d.name
ORDER BY 
    total_annual_payroll DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    p.project_code,
    p.name,
    p.budget,
    COALESCE(SUM(pc.amount), 0) AS total_cost,
    CASE 
        WHEN p.budget > 0 THEN (COALESCE(SUM(pc.amount), 0) / p.budget) * 100
        ELSE NULL
    END AS cost_percentage_of_budget
FROM 
    analytics.projects p
LEFT JOIN 
    analytics.project_costs pc ON p.id = pc.project_id
GROUP BY 
    p.project_code, p.name, p.budget
ORDER BY 
    cost_percentage_of_budget DESC;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN d.name = 'Engineering' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS engineering_headcount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN d.name = 'Finance' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS finance_headcount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN d.name = 'Engineering' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN d.name = 'Finance' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS headcount_difference
FROM 
    analytics.employees e
JOIN 
    analytics.departments d ON e.department_id = d.id
WHERE 
    e.status = 'active'
    AND d.name IN ('Engineering', 'Finance');
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM analytics.customers GROUP BY status;

SELECT 
    d.name AS department_name,
    SUM(p.base_salary + p.bonus - p.deductions) AS total_payroll
FROM 
    analytics.departments d
JOIN 
    analytics.employees e ON d.id = e.department_id
JOIN 
    analytics.payroll p ON e.id = p.employee_id
GROUP BY 
    d.name
ORDER BY 
    total_payroll DESC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_employee_count
FROM analytics.employees e
JOIN analytics.departments d ON e.department_id = d.id
WHERE d.name = 'Engineering'
  AND e.status = 'Active';
SELECT project_code, name, budget FROM analytics.projects WHERE status = 'active' ORDER BY budget DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    p.id AS project_id,
    p.name AS project_name,
    COALESCE(SUM(i.total_amount), 0) AS total_revenue,
    COALESCE(SUM(pc.amount), 0) AS total_costs,
    (COALESCE(SUM(i.total_amount), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(pc.amount), 0)) AS profit
FROM analytics.projects p
LEFT JOIN analytics.invoices i ON p.id = i.project_id
LEFT JOIN analytics.project_costs pc ON p.id = pc.project_id
GROUP BY p.id, p.name
ORDER BY profit DESC;
